meta.title: Ollama Vector Memory
meta.description: Two-tier long-term memory: a core memory file injected into the system prompt every turn, plus a local vector store (Ollama embeddings). Structured kinds, save de-duplication, capacity governance (archive on overflow), supersede semantics, artifact fingerprint staleness detection, and weighted retrieval (similarity x time decay x kind weight). Retrieval degrades to keyword matching when embeddings are unavailable.
